_comment: Per-role MCP surface budgets over the canonical builtin and discovery definitions (ORB-21263). role_surface_budget fails when a role's tools or approximate tokens exceed its budget. Raising a budget is a reviewed decision: say in the PR why the role needs the extra surface. The resident role needs orbit.resident.metrics to inspect read-only mandate history, and orbit.evolution.add/list/show to record and read cost events; operator and manager include the resident toolset. The read-only orbit.resident.digest adds one tool to those three roles. The read-only orbit.attention task-level feed belongs to tasks-read, shared by every role and the default surface (ORB-21168). Its filter and cursor schema requires token budget increases in all six surfaces; only operator, manager and resident need an extra tool slot. Measured totals are default 41/~23638, operator 83/~41412, manager 27/~13409, resident 36/~22565, agent 32/~19156 and reader 14/~7546; token ceilings round these totals up to the next hundred. `orbit tool list --role <role>` reports the current size.
